info.title: mirror-v3 cache
info.description: Drop-in HTTP surface for Yolean/kafka-keyvalue's /cache/v1. The state is a merged in-memory `key → latest-value` view across every mirror with `http-access: { api: cache-v1 }`. Updates are per-record from the consume loop; reads return 503 until every registered mirror has caught up to its startup high-watermark.

TopicPartitionOffsetJson.description:
`{topic, partition, offset}` shape serialized into the
`x-kkv-last-seen-offsets` header. Mirrors KKV's
`TopicPartitionOffset`, including JSON property order.
